title: Bug 648962: Create transfer order shows generic error when existing transfers cover subcontracting demand
summary: The Create Transfer Order report now distinguishes between demand that is fully covered by existing transfers and truly ineligible demand, providing users with an actionable error message and navigation option to view related open transfer orders instead of a generic error.
key_points: Tracks covered positive eligible demand separately from cases with zero demand
Provides actionable error message when all demand is covered by existing open, in-transit, or posted transfers
Offers navigation to view related open transfer orders when available
Reuses subcontracting factbox helper for consistent navigation behavior
Low-risk change limited to error handling and navigation, no impact on transfer quantity calculation
